disposition_reason: Three wild edible saprophytic mushroom species (Agaricus macrocarpus, Clitocybe inversa, Macrolepiota procera) collected in 2012 at three Croatian forest sites, analysed for iron, zinc, copper, nickel, lead and cadmium by XRF; means by species and site (Table 2) and by cap and stipe (Table 3).

study.design: Field collection of wild fruiting bodies with paired topsoil
study.origin: Forest areas of Petrova gora, Jaska (near Izimje village) and Trakošćan, continental Croatia
study.method: Drying 103 °C, pressed briquettes, XRF (Twinx, PIN detector)

findings.material_label: Wild mushroom, wild Agaricus (Agaricus macrocarpus)
findings.group: Agaricus macrocarpus, Petrova gora forest, continental Croatia
findings.notes: Least-squares mean (letters = significance groups); fruiting bodies dried at 103 °C; no SD printed. Number of fruiting bodies per species-site cell not clearly stated (20 per species collected; F-test df 8,141). Table 2 is read as the whole fruiting body (cap and stipe were analysed separately, Table 3).
